events.verdict: Ayton (POR) makes clean contact with the ball to block Cunningham's (DET) shot at the basket. Any ensuing follow-through arm contact after the block is incidental.
Harris (DET) and Camara (POR) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Harris (DET) legally contests Simons' (POR) jump shot attempt.
Simons (POR) briefly wraps an arm around Harris (DET) as the two players jostle and Harris is able to move freely through the contact.
Simons (POR) maintains a legal guarding position during Cunningham's (DET) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Duren (DET) makes contact with the ball after it bounces off the rim and exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Cunningham (DET) legally contests Avdija's (POR) jump shot attempt.
Avdija's (POR) shot attempt is not touched by any defender and bounces directly out of bounds.
Camara (POR) cleanly deflects Cunningham's (DET) pass attempt and the ball goes out of bounds.
Cunningham (DET) grasps and then quickly releases Camara's (POR) jersey off ball.
Sharpe (POR) commits a take foul on Hardaway Jr. (DET).
Simons (POR) commits a take foul on Beasley (DET).
Beasley (DET) legally contests Simons' (POR) jump shot attempt.

Simons (POR) moves laterally into Beasley's (DET) path and initiates the illegal body contact that affects Beasley's SQBR. The illegal contact by Simons occurs before any contact initiated by Beasley.
Ayton (POR) rests his hand on Duren's (DET) body and neither extends nor delivers contact before he releases to secure the rebound.

Cunningham (DET) deflects the ball away from Sharpe (POR) prior to any incidental follow-through contact with his body. Sharpe does not touch the ball again before it goes out of bounds and possession is correctly retained by the Trail Blazers.
Beasley (DET) reaches in and any contact with Simons (POR) is marginal as he loses control of the ball on his own accord.
Beasley (DET) secures the loose ball after Simons (POR) fumbles the ball on his own accord and loses control of his dribble off his body.
